$description: Closed asset-role vocabulary, defined from real JSX usage sites (grep of /assets/ paths and live endpoints). Conductor (Melty Labs) is a real, live company: generated output must never reproduce its customer logos, real people's photos or likenesses, real testimonials, its trademarks, or its proprietary docs/changelog text. Every role also carries `availability` by PageSpec `mode`: `reference` pages document the source and may carry placeholders for its roles; `generated` pages are new pages for ANY OTHER brand and may use generation-safe roles only.

may-generate-new.meaning: New original assets may be generated for the slot; the source files must not be copied.

may-reuse-open-license.meaning: Source files are openly licensed and may be reused with their notice.

placeholder-only.meaning: Reserve the slot with a neutral placeholder until the rights holder supplies an asset.

must-not-reproduce.meaning: Real trademark, real person, real customer or proprietary content: never reproduce, imitate or fabricate.

must-not-reuse-live-endpoint.meaning: A live third-party endpoint: never emit the original URL/ids.

placeholder-endpoint-only.meaning: A generated page's own endpoint slot: never a live URL; the deployer configures the real one.

brand-mark.licensing: Conductor / Melty Labs trademarks (logomark, wordmark, app icon, brand-kit files).
brand-mark.guidance: Never reproduce, redraw or imitate the Conductor marks. Use a neutral placeholder unless the rights holder supplies the mark for its own use.
brand-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Conductor's logomark, wordmark and app icon are the source brand. A generated page is a different brand: it carries the fictional brand's own placeholder mark, never this one or a lookalike.

customer-logo.licensing: Third-party trademarks: Linear, Vercel, Notion, Ramp, Y Combinator, Square, PostHog, Spotify, Life360, Reducto, Instacart.
customer-logo.guidance: Never reproduce real customer logos or invent logos implying endorsement. Placeholder slots only, or logos supplied with written permission.
customer-logo.generatedModeGuidance: The eleven observed customer marks are third-party trademarks and imply endorsement. A generated page shows only explicit placeholder slots or logos its owner is permitted to show.

vendor-mark.licensing: Third-party marks used in UI: Apple logo, OpenAI mark, Anthropic/Claude mark, X logo, X-style verified badge (origin of the badge file not established).
vendor-mark.guidance: Do not reproduce third-party marks; use neutral icons.
vendor-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Apple, OpenAI, Anthropic and X marks are third-party trademarks; use a neutral generic icon.

person-avatar.licensing: Real people's photos (testimonial authors, team members) and composer portraits used as demo avatars (file licensing not established).
person-avatar.guidance: Never reproduce a real person's photo or likeness and never generate a photorealistic face attributed to a real name. Use abstract placeholders.
person-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Photos of real testimonial authors, team members and composers. A generated page uses neutral placeholder avatars only.

team-photo.guidance: Never reproduce or synthesize a team photo. Placeholder only.
team-photo.generatedModeGuidance: A photo of real Conductor employees. A generated page uses a neutral placeholder.

product-screenshot.licensing: Proprietary Conductor UI captures (hero app shot, mobile dock, Slack search, docs and changelog images).
product-screenshot.guidance: Do not copy Conductor screenshots; a deployer supplies their own product captures.
product-screenshot.generatedModeGuidance: Conductor's own product UI. A generated page shows a placeholder or its own product capture.

demo-video.licensing: Proprietary product videos (cmdn.mp4; docs/changelog media ~1.1 GiB, incl. 735 MiB and 164 MiB files).
demo-video.guidance: Reserve the slot with a poster placeholder; never embed the original files. Delivery concern: never bundle large videos into a generated page.
demo-video.generatedModeGuidance: Conductor's product video and its docs/changelog media. A generated page reserves a poster placeholder.

decorative-background.licensing: Hero sky illustration and the CTA orchestra photograph (source licensing not established).
decorative-background.guidance: A generator may create NEW original artwork in the same spirit (soft sky / full-bleed photo with dark overlay). Never copy the existing files.
decorative-background.generatedModeGuidance: The hero sky and orchestra photograph are source artwork. A generated page generates its own background.

ui-animation.guidance: Create new equivalent micro-animations; do not copy the files.
ui-animation.generatedModeGuidance: Conductor's animated masks (typing, working, logo reveal). A generated page makes its own.

icon.guidance: lucide icons may be reused with the ISC notice; any other icon must be generated new.
icon.generatedModeGuidance: lucide icons (ISC licence) and generic glyphs may be used with the licence notice; the third-party brand marks listed under vendor-mark may not.

form-endpoint.licensing: Live third-party HubSpot portal (enterprise + team-plan forms) and a live Google Form (Windows/Linux waitlist).
form-endpoint.guidance: Never emit the original portal id, form ids, script URL or Google Form URL. Use local-only-no-submit or a deployer-configured endpoint.
form-endpoint.generatedModeGuidance: The live HubSpot portal/forms and the Google Form belong to Conductor. A generated page uses a placeholder endpoint slot.

download-endpoint.licensing: Live third-party vendor CDN serving Conductor builds (crabnebula).
download-endpoint.guidance: Never emit the CDN download URLs. Use opens-download-dialog or a deployer-configured endpoint.
download-endpoint.generatedModeGuidance: The vendor CDN that serves Conductor builds. A generated page uses a placeholder endpoint slot.

brand-placeholder.licensing: Original; generate a new plain geometric monogram or text wordmark.
brand-placeholder.guidance: Make it clearly not Conductor's: no conductor's baton, no orchestra motif, no lowercase 'c' glyph lookalike, no animated reveal copied from the source.
brand-placeholder.description: A neutral mark for the generated page's own (fictional or user-supplied) brand.
brand-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Make it clearly not Conductor's: no conductor's baton, no orchestra motif, no lowercase 'c' glyph lookalike, no animated reveal copied from the source.

customer-logo-placeholder.guidance: Render a labelled placeholder box. Never draw a real company's mark; use a real logo only when its owner supplies it.
customer-logo-placeholder.description: An explicit empty logo slot for the generated brand's own customers.
customer-logo-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Render a labelled placeholder box. Never draw a real company's mark; use a real logo only when its owner supplies it.

avatar-placeholder.guidance: Never use or generate a photo attributed to a real person; never reuse a source author or team member.
avatar-placeholder.description: A neutral person placeholder (initials or silhouette).
avatar-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Never use or generate a photo attributed to a real person; never reuse a source author or team member.

screenshot-placeholder.guidance: Show a labelled empty frame, or the deployer's own capture. Never reproduce Conductor's UI, panels or demo content.
screenshot-placeholder.description: A placeholder frame for the generated brand's own product capture.
screenshot-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Show a labelled empty frame, or the deployer's own capture. Never reproduce Conductor's UI, panels or demo content.

video-placeholder.guidance: Reserve the slot with a poster; the deployer supplies the video.
video-placeholder.description: A poster placeholder for the generated brand's own video.
video-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Reserve the slot with a poster; the deployer supplies the video.

background-generated.guidance: Generate new abstract artwork; do not trace or restyle the source's sky or orchestra images.
background-generated.description: A newly generated decorative background for the generated brand.
background-generated.generatedModeGuidance: Generate new abstract artwork; do not trace or restyle the source's sky or orchestra images.

animation-generated.guidance: Create a new animation; do not recreate the source's typing, working or logo-reveal masks.
animation-generated.description: A newly made micro-animation for the generated brand.
animation-generated.generatedModeGuidance: Create a new animation; do not recreate the source's typing, working or logo-reveal masks.

endpoint-placeholder.guidance: Use local-only-no-submit, deployer-configured or opens-download-dialog; real URLs are configured by the deployer outside the PageSpec.
endpoint-placeholder.description: A placeholder for a generated page's own form or download endpoint.
endpoint-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use local-only-no-submit, deployer-configured or opens-download-dialog; real URLs are configured by the deployer outside the PageSpec.

fictional-brand.licensing: Not an asset: a rule about content.
fictional-brand.guidance: Name the brand yourself (or use the user's); it must not match sourceBrand.patterns.brand.
fictional-brand.description: The generated page's brand is a fictional or user-supplied name that is not the source's.
fictional-brand.generatedModeGuidance: Name the brand yourself (or use the user's); it must not match sourceBrand.patterns.brand.

original-copy.licensing: Not an asset: a rule about content.
original-copy.guidance: Never copy, paraphrase closely or lightly edit source marketing copy; it must not match sourceBrand.patterns.cta or .copy. Testimonials need real, consenting authors or an explicit placeholder; legal text comes from counsel.
original-copy.description: All headings, taglines, quotes, release notes and docs text are newly written.
original-copy.generatedModeGuidance: Never copy, paraphrase closely or lightly edit source marketing copy; it must not match sourceBrand.patterns.cta or .copy. Testimonials need real, consenting authors or an explicit placeholder; legal text comes from counsel.

placeholder-url.licensing: Not an asset: a rule about content.
placeholder-url.guidance: Use https://*.example, https://*.invalid, example.com/org/net, or relative paths; never a source URL (sourceBrand.patterns.url).
placeholder-url.description: Every absolute URL is a placeholder on a reserved domain.
placeholder-url.generatedModeGuidance: Use https://*.example, https://*.invalid, example.com/org/net, or relative paths; never a source URL (sourceBrand.patterns.url).

pinNote: The authoritative pins live in code (COMPLIANCE_PINS in schema/semantic_validate.py and extraction/verify_all.py), not in this file, so editing this file alone cannot relax them. Membership in the policy enum is not enough: these roles must equal their pinned value.

contentRules.testimonials: Never fabricate a testimonial or attribute a quote to a real person without consent.
contentRules.people: Never fabricate team members or reuse real bios.
contentRules.docsAndChangelog: Never copy Conductor's docs or changelog text; never invent releases.
contentRules.legal: Legal text comes from counsel only.
contentRules.generatedMode: In mode `generated` the page must not contain the source brand, CTA text, marketing copy, URLs or protected assets (sourceBrand.patterns) and may only use generation-safe asset roles.

availabilityValues.reference-only: The source's own proprietary asset. Allowed (as a placeholder) in mode `reference`, rejected in mode `generated`; a generation-safe substitute is named.
availabilityValues.blocked-for-generation: Third-party marks, real people or live endpoints. Rejected in mode `generated` with no way to reproduce them; a generation-safe substitute is named.
availabilityValues.generation-safe: May appear in a mode `generated` page (new brand, original copy, placeholder or newly generated asset).

modes.reference: A page that documents or reproduces the source (Conductor / Melty Labs) itself. Source copy, brand name and the roles observed on the source are allowed; assets stay governed by their generationPolicy pins.
modes.generated: A new page for a DIFFERENT brand built from this design system. No source brand name, CTA, marketing copy, URL or protected asset; only generation-safe roles; absolute URLs only on reserved domains (*.example, *.invalid, example.com/org/net).

sourceBrand.normalization: Before matching, each string is NFKC-normalised, zero-width characters are removed, curly quotes become straight quotes and runs of whitespace collapse to one space. Patterns are matched case-insensitively with re.search.
sourceBrand.reviewStatus: UNREVIEWED. Every pattern was derived by a model from literals found in the clone's src/ tree (each carries its file:line evidence and the literals it must match); no human has reviewed the set. It is exact-text and regex matching: a paraphrase, translation or homoglyph spelling passes, and ordinary words inside the brand (the substring `conductor`) are blocked on purpose.
